boundaries: A = complete source reading; B = complete machine/metadata checks; C = sampling; D = inference/unverified. Only scoped A/B source files enter this denominator.
Zero scoped C/D does not mean the entire inherited repository or dependencies were read; full outside-scope paths and reasons are separate.
Canonical local execution proofs are summarized directly; no cloud CI, real customer, real payment, device control or physical work success is inferred.
Original execution receipts remain version/time bound and immutable; this aggregation performs no tests and relabels no past run.
